newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Good results expected at Micron.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Good results expected at Micron.

text.p: Investors in Micron Technology Inc options were betting the company would post solid fourth quarter results later on Thursday, traders said.
"There's a huge amount of call buyers speculating on good earnings it looks like," a trader on the Pacific Stock Exchange, where Micron options trade, said.
The company's fourth quarter profits are expected to be released after the stock market closes at 1500 CDT (2000 GMT).
By 1310 CDT (1810 GMT), the Micron September 25 and September 27-1/2 calls traded 3,900 and 3,850 contracts, respectvely.
Micron shares were up 2-5/8 at 28 on heavy volume of more than seven million shares.
October calls on Micron were also active, led by the October 30 calls, which traded mreo than 3,600 contracts. The October 30, up 11/16 at 1-7/16, had open interest of nearly 18,000.
Calls were busy all the way out to January 1997, where the 30 strike traded mroe than 4,300 contracts and the 40 strike traded nearly 4,000.
The September 25 put, down 3/16 at 11/16, traded nearly 3,400 contracts. The October 25 put traded 2,400 and the January 1997 17-1/2 put traded more than 1,000.

The trader on the Pacific Stock Exchange said news that Micron had asked the U.S. Commerce Department to expand its investigation of alleged chip dumping by Korean semiconductor makers Hyundai Electronics Industries and LG Semicon helped boost the stock and the call buying.
He said volatilities on the Micron calls had surged since Tuesday, when Micron said it would release its quarterly earnings on Thursday instead of next Monday.
Activity was strong from both institutional and retail investors, the trader added.
